answer: Every new agent's stake must land at a public wharf that logs the full funding path of each deposit. Identities whose coins trace back to a shared source wallet are planted in one orchard row, and that row shares a single reward and vote cap, so splitting into ten agents earns no more than one. Each epoch a beacon publishes the clustering so peers can dispute mistakes. To dodge it, an attacker must buy independently sourced coins for every fake through separate channels, paying real fees and delay each time.
